title: Patch: named layers, corner radii and shadow depths, and gradients only where they mean something
thread:
**Issue #2109 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2109: Patch: named layers, corner radii and shadow depths, and gradients only where they mean something
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Corner radii, stacking order, shadows and gradients are each chosen one at a time, and nearly every surface has a gradient and a soft shadow. That is a well-known look of generated UI, and when everything is raised nothing stands out. Give the board a few named radii, named layers for what sits above what, a few shadow depths, and keep gradients for the places they mean something (cards, the main button, the table). Everything else goes flat.

### Acceptance

- The board uses named radii, layers and shadow depths.
- Gradients appear only where they mean something.
- What sits on top of what on the board is unchanged.

### Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2107

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40715328490)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The board gets named surface tokens, following the #2105 palette and #2107 type-scale pattern: a new `surfaces.css` names every corner radius, every stacking level and every neutral shadow depth, board stylesheets use only those names, and background gradients survive only where they mean something (card faces in `src/cards/`, the main-button `--primary-face*` tokens, the table in `game/table.css`). Everything else goes flat. Stacking order is unchanged by construction, because each layer token holds its level's current number.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/surfaces.css` | new | `:root` tokens: 7 radii, 4 shadows, 21 layers (names and values in step 1) |
| `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts` | new | Enforcement tests mirroring `typescale.test.ts` |
| `apps/web/src/index.css` | change | Import `surfaces.css`; freeze `--radius`/`--seat-radius` aliases; flatten `.panel`, `.brand`, shell buttons/inputs to tokens |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | One surfaces paragraph beside the palette/type-scale ones |
| `apps/web/src/game/board.css` | change | Radii, shadows, z-index to tokens; surfaces flat (§-flat rule, step 5) |
| `apps/web/src/game/prompt.css` | change | Same; `calc(var(--radius)*1.6)` becomes `var(--radius-md)` |
| `apps/web/src/game/animations.css` | change | Same; `var(--radius, 7px)` becomes `var(--radius-sm)` |
| `apps/web/src/game/drag/drag.css` | change | Same |
| `apps/web/src/game/showcase/showcase.css` | change | Same; `7% / 5%` becomes `var(--radius-lg)` |
| `apps/web/src/game/clock.css` | change | Same |
| `apps/web/src/game/highlights.css` | change | Glow shadows stay; glow backgrounds go flat |
| `apps/web/src/game/market.css` | change | `45% 45% 40% 40%` becomes `var(--radius-round)`; `0.5rem`/`0.75rem` become `sm`/`md`; coin shading flat |
| `apps/web/src/game/countered.css` | change | Same token swap; bubble texture stays |
| `apps/web/src/game/notices.css` | change | `linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-raised), var(--bg-sunken))` becomes `var(--bg-raised)` |
| `apps/web/src/game/facedown.css` | change | Same; hatch texture stays |
| `apps/web/src/game/starscape.css` | change | Token swap |
| `apps/web/src/game/activate.css` | change | Button gradient becomes flat `var(--pal-brass-800)` |
| `apps/web/src/game/spent.css` | change | Token swap |
| `apps/web/src/game/trade.css` | change | Token swap |
| `apps/web/src/game/reveal.css` | change | Token swap |
| `apps/web/src/game/modifierList.css` | change | Token swap |
| `apps/web/src/game/craft/craft.css` | change | Token swap |
| `apps/web/src/game/leanNewest.css` | change | `6px` input radius becomes `var(--radius-sm)` |
| `apps/web/src/game/aim/opponentAim.css` | change | `59` becomes `var(--z-aim)` |
| `apps/web/src/game/lock.css` | change | `z-index: 2` becomes `var(--z-raised)`; `filter: drop-shadow` stays |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; anything in `crates/`, `spec/`, `e2e/`; `apps/web/src/game/table.css` (cosmetics, keeps its gradients); `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/`; `apps/web/src/cards/` (card gradients stay); no manifest, lockfile, or config. No spec section or ruling governs this change; none is added or cited.

## Steps

1. Create `apps/web/src/surfaces.css`. Copy the header-comment style of `typescale.css` (issue tag `#2109`, token rules, `SURFACE_MAX` pointer). Define exactly, in this order:
   - Radii: `--radius-xs: 4px; --radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 12px; --radius-lg: 16px; --radius-xl: 22px; --radius-pill: 999px; --radius-round: 50%;`
   - Shadows: `--shadow-1: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pal-black) 55%, transparent); --shadow-2: 0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pal-black) 50%, transparent); --shadow-3: 0 12px 36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--pal-black) 60%, transparent); --shadow-inset-top: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--pal-white) 7%, transparent);`
   - Layers (value equals today's number, ascending): `--z-below: -1; --z-base: 0; --z-content: 1; --z-raised: 2; --z-overlay: 3; --z-hover: 4; --z-popover: 5; --z-overflow: 18; --z-strip: 20; --z-veil: 30; --z-banner: 35; --z-market: 36; --z-clock: 37; --z-showcase: 39; --z-modal: 40; --z-result: 45; --z-spotlight: 50; --z-aim: 59; --z-drag: 60; --z-toast: 70; --z-toast-top: 72;`
2. Create `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts`. Copy `typescale.test.ts` (`SHEETS` walker, `BOARD_SHEETS` filter verbatim, `UNSCALED`-style structure not needed). Assert: token counts and shapes (7 radii in px except pill/round, ascending; 4 shadows; 21 layers strictly ascending, matching the values above); only `surfaces.css` declares `--radius-*`/`--shadow-*`/`--z-*`; `index.css` starts with the four imports in order fonts, palette, typescale, surfaces; every board sheet's `border-radius` holds only `var(--radius-*)`, `0`, or `inherit`; every `box-shadow` holds only `var(--shadow-*)`, `var(--primary-shadow)`, `none`, `inherit`, or a glow/selection ring matching `0 0 0? \d+px (var\(--(selected|legal|locked|mana|countered-rim|tap-tint)\)|color-mix\(|rgb)`; every `z-index` holds only `var(--z-*)` or `auto`; no `gradient(` in a `background`/`background-image` declaration (mask-image lines exempt); no `borderRadius`/`boxShadow`/`zIndex` or `gradient(` in `game/**/*.tsx` outside tests.
3. Edit `apps/web/src/index.css`: add `@import "./surfaces.css";` after the typescale import. Keep `--radius: 7px` with a comment that it is frozen for non-board sheets and board sheets must not use it. Flatten: `.panel` background to `var(--bg-raised)` and radius to `var(--radius-md)`; `.brand h1` to flat `color: var(--text)` (drop the `background-clip: text` lines); shell buttons/inputs `8px` to `var(--radius-sm)`; `.notice code` `4px` to `var(--radius-xs)`; `.form-card` `border-radius: 0` stays. Keep `--primary-face*` and `--primary-shadow` untouched.
4. Edit `apps/web/src/game/board.css`: `--seat-radius: 12px` becomes `--seat-radius: var(--radius-md)` (frozen alias, still declared here). Radius map: `var(--radius)` to `var(--radius-sm)`; `16px` panel to `var(--radius-lg)`; blob/near-circle values (`52% 46% 55% 44%`, `50% / 46%`, `50% 43% 52% 45%`) to `var(--radius-round)`; `0 10px 0 0` keeps its shape with `var(--radius-sm)` in place of `10px`. Shadows: drop-only blurs 10px or less to `var(--shadow-2)` with `var(--shadow-inset-top)` prepended where an inset highlight exists today; the two active-seat glows keep their `0 0 0 1px` + `0 0 18px` lines unchanged. z-index by equal value (`3` to `var(--z-overlay)`, `4` to `var(--z-hover)`, `5` to `var(--z-popover)`, `1` to `var(--z-content)`, `0` to `var(--z-base)`, `37` to `var(--z-clock)`, `20` to `var(--z-strip)`). Surfaces: seats, plates, log rows and panels go flat (`var(--bg-raised)` / `var(--bg-sunken)`); keep `--board-surface`, the locked-zone hatch, the `mask-image` fades, and hero-orb/mana-gem mid-stop colours as flat backgrounds.
5. Apply the same three swaps to `prompt.css`, `animations.css`, `drag/drag.css`, `showcase/showcase.css`, `clock.css`, `market.css`, `countered.css`, `notices.css`, `facedown.css`, `starscape.css`, `activate.css`, `spent.css`, `trade.css`, `reveal.css`, `modifierList.css`, `craft/craft.css`: radii by size (`2-5px` to `xs`, `6-9px` to `sm`, `10-12px` to `md`, `14-16px` to `lg`, `22px` to `xl`, `999px` to `pill`, `50%` to `round`; composed corners keep shape with the token substituted); neutral drops to `--shadow-1/2/3` by blur (`<=3px` to 1, `<=12px` to 2, larger to 3); z-index to the equal-valued token. Flatten every background gradient to the flat colour named in this per-file rule: prompt panels and drag sheets to `var(--bg-raised)`; `prompt.css:453` parchment gradient to `var(--pal-parchment)`; `prompt.css:552` wood gradient to `var(--pal-wood-800)`; `activate.css:27` brass gradient to `var(--pal-brass-800)`; `highlights.css:53,64` glow gradients to `var(--pal-green-500)` flat (glow `box-shadow` keeps the meaning); orbs, gems, coins and pips to their gradient's mid-stop flat colour; clock ember and showcase/market decorative washes to the underlying flat surface. Keep: `mask-image` fades, the countered bubble texture, the facedown/locked hatch, drag-reticle `radial-gradient`, and every glow/selection `box-shadow`.
6. Small sheets: `leanNewest.css` `6px` to `var(--radius-sm)`; `lock.css` `z-index: 2` to `var(--z-raised)`; `aim/opponentAim.css` `59` to `var(--z-aim)`; `overflow.css` all `18` to `var(--z-overflow)`; `trade.css` `70` to `var(--z-toast)`.
7. Append one paragraph to `apps/web/README.md` after the type-scale paragraph: surfaces live in `src/surfaces.css`, board sheets name radii/shadows/layers and keep gradients only for cards, the main button and the table, checked by `src/surfaces.test.ts`.
8. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/surfaces.test.ts`, then the palette and type-scale files (`pnpm --dir apps/web test src/palette.test.ts src/typescale.test.ts`), plus `cargo fmt --check`. Fix honestly; never weaken a test or lint to reach green.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/surfaces.test.ts`, new: `it("#2109 surfaces.css names 7 radii, 4 shadows and 21 layers in order, and nothing else")`; `it("#2109 index.css imports surfaces.css fourth and freezes the old aliases")`; `it("#2109 every var(--radius-*/--shadow-*/--z-*) names a token, and only surfaces.css declares one")`; `it("#2109 the board's stylesheets state no radius, shadow, layer or background gradient of their own")`; `it("#2109 the board's components set none inline")`. Each fails on today's literals (e.g. `border-radius: 8px` in `board.css`, `z-index: 40` in `prompt.css`, the seat gradients).
- Regression: existing `src/palette.test.ts` and `src/typescale.test.ts` stay green (their import-order prefixes still match with a fourth import line appended).
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/surfaces.test.ts`; `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/palette.test.ts src/typescale.test.ts`; `cargo fmt --check`. Visual stacking is covered in CI by the board-layout component specs; no e2e file changes.

## Done when

- [ ] Board stylesheets name only surface tokens for radii, shadows and layers; no literal remains except the allowlisted glows, `0`/`none`/`auto`/`inherit`, mask fades, hatch/bubble/reticle textures, `--board-surface` and `--primary-face*`.
- [ ] No background gradient remains in board scope outside that allowlist; cards, main button and table keep theirs.
- [ ] Every layer token holds its level's previous number, so on-top-of order is unchanged.
- [ ] `surfaces.test.ts`, `palette.test.ts`, `typescale.test.ts` pass; `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `apps/web/README.md` documents the surfaces contract.

## Risks

- Merging distinct z-values into one token could flip two overlapping elements; avoided by giving each level its own token with the identical number. Do not merge tokens without a screenshot proving the pair never overlaps.
- Flattening orbs, gems and glow backgrounds changes their look; that is the issue's intent, and the meaning stays in the `box-shadow` glows and the palette-meaning colours, which are untouched.
- `var(--radius)` without a suffix and `var(--seat-radius)` must not appear in board scope after the change; they remain defined only for unmigrated non-board sheets.

## Open questions

None. The `#2107` blocker is merged (`c7211eadc`), so this stands alone. Difficulty stays medium: over 10 files and visual polish, which the easy rule never allows.
```
